method: Downloaded Bumbeishvili and Crubadan plain-text lists and both Georgian FrequencyWords files. Removed exact Georgian strings recorded in every content/dictionaries JSON and docs/VOCABULARY*.json, including approvals, rejected alternatives, skipped proposals and historical references. Individually checked proposed senses; no new word is approved.
frequencyWarning: Downloaded subtitle frequency files contain many apparently garbled Georgian-letter strings; their frequency counts were not used to rank everyday familiarity. All selected words also occur in Bumbeishvili or Crubadan.
limitations: Owner review is complete: 72 approved, 28 rejected, plus უფარო explicitly excluded. No new boards generated, capacity/repetition improvement not measured, and active revision 28 remains unchanged. Some source pages returned HTTP 410 to download; primary-source indexed text was inspected via web search as recorded.
attribution: Discovery sources: Dato Bumbeishvili (MIT), Kevin Scannell/Crubadan (CC BY 4.0), hermitdave FrequencyWords/OpenSubtitles (CC BY-SA 4.0). Definition checks: Georgian explanatory dictionary/Linguistic Technologies Group; Wiktionary contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0); NPLG dictionaries; ena.ge; Dictionary.ge; Ilia State University Georgian Sign Language Dictionary. Short adapted English glosses only; source rights remain with their publishers. Download URLs and SHA-256 records are in artifacts/vocabulary-targeted-08/downloads.json.
